decisions.reason: This particle-therapy water phantom still builds on the firm's strong dosimetry and QA knowledge, but its narrower niche and earlier staged rollout leave some moderate risk of portfolio pruning.

A small-volume ionization chamber is highly related to the firm's calibration, detector, and clinical physics capabilities, so market feedback can be readily absorbed and turned into incremental improvements.
This chamber also fits closely with the firm's existing knowledge base, accredited calibration infrastructure, and service model, making continued support more likely than withdrawal.
A thimble ionization chamber sits at the heart of the firm's established dosimetry business, so its technical and commercial fit makes discontinuation within a year unlikely.
